title: Emit GP8 archives readable by the pinned AlphaTab inflater
scope: Fix target archive interoperability for the fifteen transposition-tonality fixtures while preserving all uncompressed member bytes and musical data.
acceptance: For all fifteen pinned guitarpro8/transposition-tonality-*.gp inputs, source loading succeeds and the current Go-exported target reproduces Invalid huffman. Keep those stages distinct in the regression.

The exported targets must pass ordinary ZIP integrity checks, Go reparse and pinned AlphaTab loading. Compare source and output semantics with the existing scoped policies; unrelated transposition losses remain visible.

Preserve member names, bytes, CRCs, archive metadata requirements and backing-track assets. The fix may change compression strategy but must not alter score.gpif semantics to avoid the inflater failure.

Add a regression sensitive to target-side decompression failures and rerun the broad probe. Its fifteen target inflater blockers must disappear without source fixture changes or an AlphaTab dependency upgrade.
exclusions: Store or another compatible ZIP profile is an implementation option; changing CreateRaw to CreateHeader alone is not evidence of a fix.
This is an interoperability failure, not proof the current archive violates ZIP. No transposition mapping changes in this ticket.

reproduction.instructions: For all fifteen pinned guitarpro8/transposition-tonality-*.gp inputs, source loading succeeds and the current Go-exported target reproduces Invalid huffman. Keep those stages distinct in the regression. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: The fixed production GP8 members use Store; generic raw-Deflate archive construction remains available for parser and malformed-input tests.
Checks exact member order, names, methods, UTF-8 and data-descriptor flags, modes, sizes, CRCs, payload identity, and optional backing-track bytes.
For all fifteen named fixtures, pinned AlphaTab loads source and stored target facts while a byte-identical legacy raw-Deflate target reproduces Invalid huffman.
Broad probe clears exactly seventeen prior target Invalid huffman failures, including all fifteen scoped transposition-tonality fixtures, with unchanged source hashes and facts.

implementation-ready: Reproduced on current code: pinned AlphaTab loads all 15 sources, rejects all 15 Go targets, and loads all 15 targets repackaged as Store with identical member bytes. The old source-side diagnosis was incorrect.

Checked all fifteen transposition-tonality source and target archives, data-identical legacy Deflate failure reproduction, stored-member consumer loading, Go reparse, ordinary ZIP integrity, member metadata/CRC/order, and backing bytes. Only container encoding is claimed; no transposition mapping is hidden or normalized by this fix.

resolution: Changed only the five fixed production GP8 members from raw Deflate to Store. VERSION, Content/, and optional backing assets remain stored; generic CreateRaw and raw-Deflate support remains unchanged for malformed and metamorphic fixtures. The archive retains member order, names, uncompressed bytes, CRCs, UTF-8 flags, no-data-descriptor headers, modes, and backing audio. Pinned AlphaTab now loads all fifteen scoped targets with their source transposition facts, while the regression still reproduces the prior Invalid huffman failure from byte-identical legacy targets. The broad probe also clears two previously blocked GP5-derived targets without changing source fixtures or expanding the oracle-breadth capability claim.
